mcq.question: Why does `load_yaml` use `yaml.safe_load` instead of `yaml.load`?

options.B: `yaml.load` can construct arbitrary Python objects from tags, so an untrusted config could run code

mcq.explanation: `safe_load` only builds plain data types. Never use full loading on files you didn't write.

mcq.question: Which standard-library module reads TOML files (Python 3.11+)?
mcq.explanation: `tomllib` is read-only and built in. Writing TOML needs a third-party package.
